sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 SAM negative: unresolved or ambiguous requested_for is refused (422)
sys_atf_test.description: A correlation id with zero active matches, and a correlation id with more than one active match, must both fail to resolve to a single subject — an un-correlatable or ambiguous push must never become an executable RITM.

sys_atf_step.description: A correlation id with no active reconciled identity resolves to zero rows — the exact condition resolveSubject() treats as a 422.

Seed two active sys_user fixtures sharing one correlation_id, then assert the query resolveSubject() runs returns more than one row — the ambiguous case it must refuse rather than resolve to the first match.
